spec.description: SMB Client Performance — displays performance of SMB connections to network shares including IOPS, latency, and data volume metrics. Converted from Splunk uberAgent dashboard.

spec.title: IOPS over time per network share (top [[TopN]])
spec.description: Stacked IOPS (read+write) over time for the top [[TopN]] shares by total IOPS. Aggregation controlled by the IOPS function variable.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let top5shares = uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| where isnotempty(SharePath_s)
| summarize TotalIOPS = sum(IOPSRead_d + IOPSWrite_d) by SharePath_s
| top [[TopN]] by TotalIOPS desc
| project SharePath_s;
uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| where SharePath_s in (top5shares)
| summarize
    avg_iops = round(avg(IOPSRead_d + IOPSWrite_d), 1),
    min_iops = round(min(IOPSRead_d + IOPSWrite_d), 1),
    max_iops = round(max(IOPSRead_d + IOPSWrite_d), 1),
    sum_iops = round(sum(IOPSRead_d + IOPSWrite_d), 1)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), SharePath_s
| extend IOPS = iff("${iops_function}" == "min", min_iops, iff("${iops_function}" == "max", max_iops, avg_iops))
| project TimeGenerated, SharePath_s, IOPS
| order by TimeGenerated asc

uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| summarize
    ReadVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBRead_d), 1),
    WriteVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBWrite_d), 1),
    TotalMB = round(sum(IOMBRead_d) + sum(IOMBWrite_d), 1)
  by SharePath_s
| top [[TopN]] by TotalMB desc
| project SharePath_s, ReadVolumeMB, WriteVolumeMB

uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| summarize
    SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead_d), SumCountRead = sum(IOCountRead_d),
    SumDurWrite = sum(IOLatencyMsWrite_d), SumCountWrite = sum(IOCountWrite_d),
    SumDurRW = sum(IOLatencyMsRead_d) + sum(IOLatencyMsWrite_d),
    SumCountRW = sum(IOCountRead_d) + sum(IOCountWrite_d)
  by SharePath_s
| extend
    AvgReadLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRead > 0, SumDurRead / SumCountRead, 0.0), 1),
    AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountWrite > 0, SumDurWrite / SumCountWrite, 0.0), 1),
    AvgRWLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRW > 0, SumDurRW / SumCountRW, 0.0), 1)
| top [[TopN]] by AvgRWLatencyMs desc
| project SharePath_s, AvgReadLatencyMs, AvgWriteLatencyMs

uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| summarize
    ReadVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBRead_d), 1),
    WriteVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBWrite_d), 1)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)

uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| summarize
    SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead_d), SumCountRead = sum(IOCountRead_d),
    SumDurWrite = sum(IOLatencyMsWrite_d), SumCountWrite = sum(IOCountWrite_d)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| extend
    AvgReadLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRead > 0, SumDurRead / SumCountRead, 0.0), 1),
    AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountWrite > 0, SumDurWrite / SumCountWrite, 0.0), 1)
| project TimeGenerated, AvgReadLatencyMs, AvgWriteLatencyMs

spec.title: Data table
spec.description: SMB client performance detail. Use the Group by and IOPS function variables to change the view. Latency columns have gauge-style cells with green/yellow/red thresholds at 5ms and 20ms.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| summarize
    ReadIOCount = sum(IOCountRead_d),
    WriteIOCount = sum(IOCountWrite_d),
    MetadataIOCount = sum(IOCountMetadata_d),
    SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead_d),
    SumDurWrite = sum(IOLatencyMsWrite_d),
    SumIOMBRead = sum(IOMBRead_d),
    SumIOMBWrite = sum(IOMBWrite_d),
    avg_iops_read = round(avg(IOPSRead_d), 1), min_iops_read = round(min(IOPSRead_d), 1), max_iops_read = round(max(IOPSRead_d), 1),
    avg_iops_write = round(avg(IOPSWrite_d), 1), min_iops_write = round(min(IOPSWrite_d), 1), max_iops_write = round(max(IOPSWrite_d), 1),
    avg_iops_meta = round(avg(IOPSMetadata_d), 1), min_iops_meta = round(min(IOPSMetadata_d), 1), max_iops_meta = round(max(IOPSMetadata_d), 1),
    ShareCount = dcount(SharePath_s),
    HostCount = dcount(Computer)
  by SharePath_s
| extend
    AvgReadLatencyMs = round(iff(ReadIOCount > 0, SumDurRead / ReadIOCount, 0.0), 1),
    AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(iff(WriteIOCount > 0, SumDurWrite / WriteIOCount, 0.0), 1),
    IOPSRead = iff("${iops_function}" == "min", min_iops_read, iff("${iops_function}" == "max", max_iops_read, avg_iops_read)),
    IOPSWrite = iff("${iops_function}" == "min", min_iops_write, iff("${iops_function}" == "max", max_iops_write, avg_iops_write)),
    IOPSMetadata = iff("${iops_function}" == "min", min_iops_meta, iff("${iops_function}" == "max", max_iops_meta, avg_iops_meta)),
    ReadVolumeMB = round(SumIOMBRead, 1),
    WriteVolumeMB = round(SumIOMBWrite, 1)
| project SharePath_s, ReadIOCount, WriteIOCount, MetadataIOCount, AvgReadLatencyMs, AvgWriteLatencyMs, IOPSRead, IOPSWrite, IOPSMetadata, ReadVolumeMB, WriteVolumeMB, ShareCount, HostCount
| order by SharePath_s asc

uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| summarize
    ReadVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBRead_d), 1),
    WriteVolumeMB = round(sum(IOMBWrite_d), 1),
    TotalMB = round(sum(IOMBRead_d) + sum(IOMBWrite_d), 1)
  by Computer
| top [[TopN]] by TotalMB desc
| project Computer, ReadVolumeMB, WriteVolumeMB

uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL

| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| summarize SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead_d), SumCountRead = sum(IOCountRead_d)
| extend Value = round(iff(SumCountRead > 0, SumDurRead / SumCountRead, 0.0), 1)
| project Value

uberAgent_System_SmbClient_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ("${host}" == "All" or Computer == "${host}")
| summarize
    SumDurRead = sum(IOLatencyMsRead_d), SumCountRead = sum(IOCountRead_d),
    SumDurWrite = sum(IOLatencyMsWrite_d), SumCountWrite = sum(IOCountWrite_d),
    SumDurRW = sum(IOLatencyMsRead_d) + sum(IOLatencyMsWrite_d),
    SumCountRW = sum(IOCountRead_d) + sum(IOCountWrite_d)
  by Computer
| extend
    AvgReadLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRead > 0, SumDurRead / SumCountRead, 0.0), 1),
    AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountWrite > 0, SumDurWrite / SumCountWrite, 0.0), 1),
    AvgRWLatencyMs = round(iff(SumCountRW > 0, SumDurRW / SumCountRW, 0.0), 1)
| top [[TopN]] by AvgRWLatencyMs desc
| project Computer, AvgReadLatencyMs, AvgWriteLatencyMs
